en_h: What do you wish someone had told you in your first week of dialysis?
qen: Reply to this story. It comes to my DMs, nobody else sees it.
ar: شو كنت بتتمنّى حدا يقلّك بأوّل جمعة غسيل كلى؟
qar: ردّ عالستوري، بتوصل عالخاص وما حدا غيري بيشوفها.
en: What do you wish someone had told you in your first week of dialysis?
